assetNumber.label: Asset Number
assetNumber.tooltip: Enter it manually, or enable auto-generation

autoGenerate.label: Auto-generate asset numbers
autoGenerate.tooltip: When enabled, each device gets a different unique number (ZC-YYYYMMDD-HHmmss-XXXX)
autoGenerate.hintBatch: A unique number will be generated for each device (ZC-YYYYMMDD-HHmmss-XXXX)
autoGenerate.hint: A unique number will be generated automatically (ZC-YYYYMMDD-HHmmss-XXXX)

warrantyEnd.label: Warranty Expiry
warrantyEnd.tooltip: Pick a date directly, or click the "Quick" button on the right to derive it from "Warranty Start" by 1/2/3/5 years
warrantyEnd.popoverTitle: Derive the expiry date from "Warranty Start"

onlineDate.label: Online Date
onlineDate.tooltipDefault: Defaults to the time the device is added and can be changed manually; clearing it recalculates the lifecycle from the edit date
onlineDate.tooltip: Clearing it recalculates the lifecycle from the edit date

offlineDate.label: Offline Date
offlineDate.tooltip: Once filled in, "Expected Lifespan" is derived automatically; when both are set, the longer one wins and is synced

lifecycleYears.label: Expected Lifespan
lifecycleYears.tooltip: Once filled in, "Offline Date" is derived automatically; when both are set, the longer one wins and is synced

empty.noPosition: No cabinet positions yet. Set the row and column in the cabinet form.
empty.noCabinetOrMarker: No cabinets or placeholders in this room yet

legend.channelHint: (Solid with end caps = enclosed, dashed = open)

conflict.cellMarkers: Placeholders also marked at this position: {{list}}
conflict.listTitle: Conflicting cabinets ({{count}}): share the same row/column with another cabinet in this room and are not shown on the plan; please fix their position
conflict.tagTip: {{cabinet}} ({{position}}) duplicates a cabinet position on the plan

cabinetForm.occupied: Row {{row}}, Col {{col}} is already occupied by cabinet {{cabinet}}
cabinetForm.occupiedHint: Only one cabinet per cell in a room. Change the row/column or the submission will be rejected.
cabinetForm.markerOccupied: This position is marked as a facility placeholder ({{type}})
cabinetForm.markerOccupiedHint: Placeholders usually mean no cabinet goes in this cell. You may still submit; the plan will flag a conflict badge.

roomLayout.positionNotSet: Not set (fill in row and column in the cabinet form)

channel.title: Configure Channels
channel.hint: Channels sit between adjacent columns: N means between column N and N+1, and 0 means outside the first column. Enclosure is the main visual cue distinguishing legacy rooms from modular ones.
channel.empty: No channels configured; no bands are drawn on the plan
channel.colNumberExtra: N = between column N and N+1; 0 = outside the first column (outside the cabinet grid)
channel.enclosedExtra: Enclosed channel with end doors/top panels, such as the enclosed cold aisle of modular rooms
channel.supplyExtra: Overhead direct blow mixes airflows; not recommended and only for low-density areas
channel.displayNameExtra: Leave blank to auto-generate from the slot, e.g. "between column 1 and 2"

message.saveFailed: Failed to save the channel configuration
message.deleteFailed: Failed to delete the channel configuration

marker.title: Manage Placeholders
marker.hint: Placeholders mark cells that cannot hold cabinets — doors, precision AC, PDU, pillars. Row/col 0 means outside the cabinet grid (e.g. a door outside column 1). This is a positioning aid only, not an asset register.
marker.rowExtra: 0 means outside the cabinet grid (e.g. an end-of-row AC)
marker.colExtra: 0 means outside the cabinet grid (e.g. an end AC or door)
marker.label: Label
marker.labelExtra: Leave blank to show the type, e.g. "Air conditioner"
marker.occupiedTitle: A cabinet already occupies this position
marker.occupiedContent: {{position}} already has cabinet {{cabinet}}. Adding a placeholder will share the same cell and the plan will show a conflict badge. Continue?

message.versionConflict: Marker was modified by someone else. The list has been refreshed — please edit again
